label: scope-audit
command:
import json, re, subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from dotenv import dotenv_values

root = Path.cwd()
directory = root / "docs/validation/2026-10-22-openai-live-smoke"
host = json.loads((directory / "attempt-host/result.json").read_text())
sandbox = json.loads((directory / "attempt-sandbox/result.json").read_text())
assert host["passed"] is True and sandbox["passed"] is False
assert sandbox["requests"] == []
assert all(s["failure_kind"] == "timeout" for s in sandbox["steps"][:3])
assert len(host["requests"]) == 4
assert [s["http_requests"] for s in host["steps"]] == [1, 1, 2, 0]
assert all(s["passed"] for s in host["steps"])
assert all(r["http_status"] == 200 and r["completed"] and r["response_model_matches"] and r["policy_matches"] for r in host["requests"])
assert host["requests"][1]["json_object_mode"]
assert host["requests"][3]["tool_ids_paired"]
assert host["requests"][3]["tool_call_count"] == host["requests"][3]["tool_result_count"] == 1
assert sum(r["usage"]["input_tokens"] for r in host["requests"]) == 223
assert sum(r["usage"]["output_tokens"] for r in host["requests"]) == 49
assert json.loads((directory / "live-host.log").read_text()) == host
checks = [json.loads(line) for line in (directory / "checks.jsonl").read_text().splitlines()]
assert len({c["label"] for c in checks}) == len(checks)
for c in checks:
    assert c["environment_keys"] == ["PATH"]
    assert (directory / (c["label"] + ".log")).exists()
    expected_timeout = c["label"] in {"test-sandbox", "probe-sandbox", "live-sandbox"}
    assert c["timed_out"] is expected_timeout
    assert c["exit_code"] == (-9 if expected_timeout else 0)
assert "556 passed in 20.67s" in (directory / "test-host.log").read_text()
links = re.findall(r"\]\(([^)]+)\)", (directory / "README.md").read_text())
for link in links:
    if not link.startswith("https://"):
        assert (directory / link).is_file()
configured = dotenv_values(root / ".env")
secrets = [value for name, value in configured.items() if name.endswith("_API_KEY") and value]
pattern = re.compile(r"sk-(?:proj-|svcacct-)?[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,}|gsk_[A-Za-z0-9]{20,}|lsv2_[A-Za-z0-9_]{20,}")
files = [p for p in directory.rglob("*") if p.is_file()]
for path in files:
    content = path.read_text()
    assert not pattern.search(content), "Credential pattern found"
    assert not any(secret in content for secret in secrets), "Configured credential found"
staged = subprocess.check_output(["git", "diff", "--cached", "--name-only"], text=True).splitlines()
assert staged and all(p.startswith("docs/validation/2026-10-22-openai-live-smoke/") for p in staged)
assert not subprocess.check_output(["git", "diff", "--name-only"], text=True).strip()
ignored = subprocess.check_output(["git", "check-ignore", ".env", "REFACTORING_PLAN.md"], text=True).splitlines()
assert ignored == [".env", "REFACTORING_PLAN.md"]
subprocess.run(["git", "diff", "--cached", "--check"], check=True)
print("PASS: live request policy, model, JSON mode, tool IDs, usage, step results and log agreement")
print("PASS: retained sandbox failures, command metadata, offline suite count and local links")
print("PASS: credential-pattern and configured-key absence checks; no values printed")
print("PASS: staged scope, diff whitespace, private-file ignores and unchanged application")
print("Files inspected:", len(files))
